headers.comment: Default: revalidate. Above all this covers index.html — a stale index.html pins users to the previous build's hashed assets, and Firebase's default max-age=3600 made each deploy invisible for up to an hour. Listed first because later matching rules win.
Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a given URL's bytes never change and it can be cached forever. Must stay after the ** rule to override it.
